body_html:
How to think about it

  • Coins: ₹1, ₹2, ₹5, ₹10, ₹20. Notes: ₹10, ₹20, ₹50, ₹100, ₹200.
  • To find the cost of two things, add. To find change, subtract the price from the money given.

Examples

Example

A kite costs ₹12. You pay with a ₹20 note.

₹20 − ₹12

Answer: ₹8 change

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting coins instead of their valueAdd the amounts written on them.
Adding when finding changeChange is the money given minus the price.

faq.a: The money you get back when you pay more than the price.
